#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="09010">

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="09011">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />9011 BLM - Assigned GQ uses splits for component characterization when hexanes+ (C6+) mol% exceeds 0.5%</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="09011">

This exception can only be generated for a BLM-enabled meter. BLM requires that if the C6+ of an analysis exceeds 0.5%, then a C6+ split cannot be used to calculate heating value and other properties. BLM requires either a C9 analysis or the use of a C6+ characterization in these cases. This exception indicates that a C6+ split is inappropriately being used and that one of the two alternatives is required.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="09012">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />9012 BLM - C6+ split is not 60-30-10</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="09012">

This exception can only be generated for a BLM-enabled meter. In the calculation of heating value and other analysis properties, BLM requires that, when a C6+ split is permitted, the split ratio must be 60-30-10. This exception indicates that a split ratio other than 60-30-10 has been used.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="09013">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />9013 BLM - C6+ characterization date is approaching the six-month limit for a very high volume meter</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="09013">

This exception can only be generated for a BLM-enabled meter. BLM permits the use of a C6+ characterization (as determined from a prior C9 or greater analysis), rather than a fixed C6+ split ratio, for the calculation of heating value and other analysis properties. The C6+ characterization must be updated at least every 6 months for very high volume meters. This exception indicates that the current C6+ characterization is approaching its six-month expiration date.

 This exception will begin generating when the characterization is 135 days old, rather than 180 days old, to allow for a 45-day grace period (15 days before a monthly analysis would be due).

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="09014">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />9014 BLM - C6+ characterization is approaching the one-year limit for a high volume meter</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="09014">

This exception can only be generated for a BLM-enabled meter. BLM permits the use of a C6+ characterization (as determined from a prior C9 or greater analysis), rather than a fixed C6+ split ratio, for the calculation of heating value and other analysis properties. The C6+ characterization must be updated at least every 12 months for high volume meters. This exception indicates that the current C6+ characterization is approaching its one-year expiration date.

This exception will actually begin generating when the characterization is 255 days old, rather than 365 days old, to allow for a 105-day grace period (15 days before a quarterly analysis would be due).

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="09015">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />9015 BLM - Heptane (C7) mol% is missing</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="09015">

This exception can only be generated for a BLM-enabled meter. BLM requires that the hydrocarbon components C7, C8 and C9 always be included when a C9 analysis is used. This exception indicates that heptane is missing from such an analysis.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="09016">

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="09017">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />9017 BLM - Nonane (C9) mol% is missing</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="09017">

This exception can only be generated for a BLM-enabled meter. BLM requires that the hydrocarbon components C7, C8 and C9 always be included when a C9 analysis is used. This exception indicates that nonane is missing from such an analysis.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="09018">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />9018 BLM - C6+ characterization is incomplete</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="09018">

This exception can only be generated for a BLM-enabled meter. BLM permits the use of a C6+ characterization (as determined from a prior C9 or greater analysis), rather than a fixed C6+ split ratio, for the calculation of heating value and other analysis properties. This exception indicates that one of the characterization values is missing. The required C6+ characterization values are molar mass, gas relative density, gas/liquid volume ratio and gross heating value.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="9019">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />9019 BLM - C6+ characterization date is older than the six month limit for a very high volume meter</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="9019">

This exception can only be generated for a BLM-enabled meter. BLM permits the use of a C6+ characterization (as determined from a prior C9 or greater analysis), rather than a fixed C6+ split ratio, for the calculation of heating value and other analysis properties. The C6+ characterization must be updated at least every six months for very high volume meters. This exception indicates that the current C6+ characterization is older then the allowed six-month period.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="9020">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />9020 BLM - C6+ characterization date is older than the one year limit for a high volume meter</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="9020">

This exception can only be generated for a BLM-enabled meter. BLM permits the use of a C6+ characterization (as determined from a prior C9 or greater analysis), rather than a fixed C6+ split ratio, for the calculation of heating value and other analysis properties. The C6+ characterization must be updated at least every 12 months for high volume meters. This exception indicates that the current C6+ characterization is older then the allowed one-year period.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="9021">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />9021 BLM - Heating value uncertainty exceeds designated limit</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="9021">

This exception can only be generated for a BLM-enabled meter. The BLM requires uncertainty to be calculated for heating values. This exception indicates the calculated uncertainty value is higher than the maximum uncertainty allowed. For meters with an FMP Tier of Very High, the limit is 1%. For meters with an FMP Tier of High, the limit is 2%.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="9022">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />9022 BLM - Heating value uncertainty cannot be calculated (calculation requires at least five analyses)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="9022">

This exception can only be generated for a BLM-enabled meter. The BLM requires uncertainty to be calculated for heating values. For uncertainty to be calculated at least five analyses must be present, each with a unique lab date. This exception indicates there are less than five analyses or the analyses do not have at least five unique lab dates.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="9023">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />9023 BLM - Heating value uncertainty cannot be calculated (multiple heating values with same lab date)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="9023">

This exception can only be generated for a BLM-enabled meter. The BLM requires uncertainty to be calculated for heating values. This exception indicates that uncertainty calculation cannot be performed due to different heating values with the same lab date.

</div>
